meta.description: Product-specific rules of origin (PSRO) for the launch set of HS chapters. Each rule lists one or more options; a good meets the rule if it satisfies ANY option. 'shift' is the tariff classification change every non-originating material must make (chapter = CC, heading = CTH, subheading = CTSH). 'rvc' is the minimum regional value content in percent (tv = transaction value method, nc = net cost method).
meta.status: DRAFT - simplified encodings for engine development. Every rule must be checked line by line against CUSMA Annex 4-B (and its chapter-level exceptions) before the app gives verdicts to paying users.
